jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated System Engineer to join our IT & PMO team. The successful candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, maintaining, and monitoring IT infrastructure to ensure optimal system performance, reliability, and security.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, and maintain Windows Server and Linux environments.
  • Perform installation, configuration, and management of virtualization platforms.
  • Install, configure, and maintain network infrastructure and IT security devices.
  • Perform regular maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting of IT infrastructure and cloud environments.
  • Ensure the availability, reliability, and security of IT infrastructure systems.
  • Identify and resolve infrastructure-related issues to maintain smooth IT operations.
jobs.name: System Engineer
jobs.qualifications:
1. Educational Background:

  • Bachelor's degree (S1) in Computer Engineering, Informatics Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

2. Technical Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hardware or IT infrastructure implementation.
  • Good understanding of Windows Server and Linux operating systems.
  • Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies.
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and IT security.
  • Familiarity with network infrastructure and security devices.
  • Experience in infrastructure maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure is an advantage.
  • Windows Server or Virtualization certifications will be considered an advantage.

3. Soft Skills:

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration abilities.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

4. Language Requirements:

  • Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia.
  • English proficiency is preferred.

company.description:
Advance Innovations (AdIns) is Independent Software Vendor that established in 2000. We have comprehensive an end-to-end solution for financial businesses such as customer finance and leasing solution, mobile solution, document solution, IT training and development solution, data warehouse and business intelligent solution and payment channel solution. With all of this solutions we are a market leader in this industry with 60% of market share. AdIns has an excellent track record and 100% success rate in project implementation supported by an excellent combination of highly skilled professionals, in-depth business understanding, and extensive experience in financial industry especially banking and multi-finance company.

Feels Like Home

We do not care about who you are, where do you come from, or the colour of your skin. You are one of us and we are one of you. AdIns is home to young innovative professionals, because we know that modern problem need a modern solution. Having fun while working will make an enjoyable, conducive, and comfortable working place and it is one of the privilege that gave to the employees.

Learning Experience

If you are looking for a job, AdIns is not the right place for you, if you have huge thirst of knowledge, AdIns is the perfect place to keep on learning and developing yourself. Learning is the journey of a lifetime, that's why AdIners aren't just encouraged but also sponsored to take a bunch of certification for free.

Same Frequency

We understand that not everyone can get along with each other and we all have a fear of being judged. You can be yourself without any hesitation because we talk in the same frequency and have the same set of mind on this world. Being bullied and be the bully with no heartache is an everyday thing.

Facility & Reward

Greater power comes with greater responsibility, no pain no gain, yin and yang, everything come in pairs and have to be balance. AdIns will see and acknowledge every skill and potential that you have, so do not be afraid and feel free to do more than what they expect. We really appreciate our loyal and dedicated employees with a further study, certification, vacation trip, etc.
